entries.zh: 禽；泛指禽鸟
entries.en: bird; fowl (any bird)

entries.zh: 禽鸟；各种鸟类的通称
entries.en: birds of any species; fowl in general

entries.zh: 鸟；飞禽
entries.en: bird (generic)

entries.zh: 猛禽；鹙（食鱼之水鸟）〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: bird of prey; ibis/stork-like bird 〔source partially damaged, uncertain〕
entries.notes: 官话栏残缺（kiă[残]），仅凭西语 ave de rapiña 与汉字鶖推断，语义不能定夺。

entries.zh: 凤；凤凰（所谓太阳之鸟，或作凤雄称）
entries.en: phoenix (fenghuang), the bird they call of the sun; the male phoenix
entries.notes: 西语 espemacho 为缩合拼法，推测 es-pare-macho（雄凤），展开依赖推断。

entries.zh: 鸳鸯之鸳；水禽〔释义后半残缺存疑〕
entries.en: the mandarin-duck yuan; water bird 〔gloss partly damaged, uncertain〕
entries.notes: 汉字鴛与音写 noān 确为鸳，西语 uspados 为 azados/patos 类缩讹，水禽义依赖推断。

entries.zh: 鹈鹕（汉字栏有鵜鶘与鵃鶘两读，存疑）；传说啄食其父母之鸟
entries.en: pelican; the bird said to strike/devour its parents (bestiarium motif)
entries.notes: 汉字栏标注疑（鵜鶘 或 鵃鶘），以中世纪兽谱鹈鹕弑亲传说贴合西语释义，展开依赖推断。

entries.zh: 天鹅；从天而降、中国皇帝取而食之的鸟
entries.en: swan; the bird that descends from heaven and is eaten by the King of China

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺〕某鸟名（彼处称之为太阳之鸟，或指鸾）
entries.en: 〔folio damaged〕a bird name; perhaaps luan, the bird they call of the sun
entries.notes: 西语栏大面积残缺，仅音写 loān/loân 可读，疑似鸾字，不能定夺。

entries.zh: 水灾；洪水之患〔汉字栏标注疑：尖〕
entries.en: flood, water disaster; the water rising
entries.notes: 西语 izquierda de agua g crecer 拼写讹误（当为 crecer el agua），汉字栏标注疑（水災/尖），判定依赖推断。

entries.zh: 胜；胜过、超出、压倒他人
entries.en: to surpass, to excel, to overcome

entries.zh: 胜过；凌驾于他人之上
entries.en: to surpass others, to outdo

entries.zh: 出萃；出类拔萃，超越众人
entries.en: to stand out among the rest, to excel all others

entries.zh: 非常；非同寻常、出众之物
entries.en: extraordinary thing, exceptional

entries.zh: 出类；出类拔萃，胜过众人
entries.en: to excel one's kind, to rise above the rest

entries.zh: 耻；羞耻、耻辱，使蒙羞
entries.en: shame, disgrace; to affront, to shame

entries.zh: 耻辱；蒙受羞辱
entries.en: shame and disgrace, humiliation

entries.zh: 受辱；蒙受羞辱
entries.en: to suffer disgrace, to be humiliated

entries.zh: 受耻；蒙羞、受辱
entries.en: to be shamed, to suffer shame

entries.zh: 无意思；不知羞耻、恬不知耻〔西语谓不顾体面〕
entries.en: shameless, without sense of shame (having no regard for what ought to be done)
entries.notes: 西语 notave lo que de hazer 拼写讹误难解，须结合汉字无意思反推语境，判定依赖推断。

entries.zh: 落尽面皮；颜面丢尽、厚颜无耻到不抬眼皮的程度〔西语谓不知羞耻而不敢抬头/全然无耻〕
entries.en: to lose all face utterly, to be utterly shameless

entries.zh: 素面；面无惭色、脸皮略厚而不知羞〔汉字栏标注疑：白〕
entries.en: to be somewhat shameless, with a barefaced look
entries.notes: 汉字栏素面/白面两读存疑，西语 con poco（略、稍）示意程度，判定依赖推断。

entries.zh: 薄面；稍有羞耻之心、脸皮薄〔汉字栏标注疑：溥〕
entries.en: to feel some shame, to be thin-faced
entries.notes: 汉字栏薄面/溥存疑，音写 pǒg 指向薄，判定依赖推断。
